Excited to share I joined Lance as a Founding Engineer! Before this, I'd never set foot in a hotel back office. Sitting down with housekeepers, maintenance techs, and front desk agents changed how I think about this whole industry. The amount of coordination it takes to keep a property running is staggering, and so much of it still happens through workarounds for tools that were never built for the people using them. We're fixing that, making the day-to-day communication and operations across a property something that just works. Thank you to Shreyas Diwan and my team at Salesforce for the last few years, and to the Lance founders for the opportunity. Super grateful to be part of such a talented and welcoming team, and excited for everything we're going to build. ...more ...more

After a little over a year at xAI, I decided to leave last week. This past year has been filled with a lot of laughter, challenging moments, and immense learning. Rewriting the Ads stack for a multi-billion-dollar business with a team of 15 in just 10 weeks is the kind of challenge only xAI would take on. We built a simpler stack that’s easier to understand, faster to iterate on with coding agents, and uses 600× fewer CPUs. As my first job out of school, I couldn’t have asked for a better place to work on ambitious problems with an exceptional team. Im including a photo from April 2024 when I first entered the office for a hackathon - I had no idea the journey and learnings that would follow from that day. While I’m sad to leave my team, I’m excited for what’s next. I’ll be starting a new chapter later this month, but for now am enjoying some time with family. I’ll be moving up to SF so if you’re in the area and want to catch up, let me know! ...more ...more

Chert (YC P26) is building the infrastructure for teams to send, receive, and automate conversations over iMessage using APIs. iMessage is one of the most trusted and widely used messaging channels in the U.S. People use it every day to talk with friends, book appointments, coordinate plans, and have conversations. But for businesses, iMessage is still very difficult to automate programmatically. Chert is changing that by giving teams API access to iMessage. They’re already working with B2C startups, customer experience teams, and sales teams to reach end users through trusted and conversational messaging. Congrats on the launch, Gary Gao and Ian Fong ! https://lnkd.in/g7EAXFJf ...more ...more
